}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "Scalys", "Grapeboard" and "SES-LS1012A V1" are silkscreened on board top.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''[[NXP]]'' LS1012A @800MHz :Single-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Storage: 64MB SPI (NOR), 1MB (NOR) Flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 1GB (DDR3L) SDRAM *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Wi-Fi: [[Realtek]] RTL8723BU (2.4GHz 1T1R 802.11bgn) *Network: 2x GbE ports *PCI: 1x PCIe 2.1 M.2 (M-Key) slot *GPIO: 1x 26-pin headers *Power: 4.5 to 16V DC input via barrel jack
==Links of Interest== *[https://linuxgizmos.com/raspberry-pi-sized-sbc-runs-linux-on-single-core-cortex-a53-soc/ ''Raspberry Pi sized SBC runs Linux'' on '''LinuxGizmos'''] *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2017/12/30/grapeboard-raspberry-pi-lookalike-board-comes-with-dual-gigabit-ethernet-two-usb-3-0-ports/ ''Grapeboard Raspberry Pi Lookalike'' on '''CNX-Software'''] *[https://github.com/ms-iot/lsdk/blob/master/Readme.md ''Getting started on LS1012 Grapeboard'' on '''GitHub''']
